speaker: VOICE
text: This is the Tidal Archive—the part of Arin's memory where the accident begins to break apart.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: I remember the warning. I don't want to remember what I did next.

speaker: VOICE
text: Recover the three scattered fragments. Once they're found, arrange the four events in the order they happened.

speaker: VOICE
text: The Memory Tide sweeps through this archive. When it rises, get into cover until it passes.
